title: Chips and Code — from signal to software
voice_direction: Natural, clear English. Calm, precise, curious. About 110 words per minute. No theatrical emphasis. Leave breathing room between layers.

segments.title: Two states.
segments.narration: Every computer begins with two states. Zero and one.

segments.title: Signals become logic.
segments.narration: Connect those signals through logic gates, and simple rules become useful behavior.

segments.title: Logic becomes arithmetic.
segments.narration: Combine gates into arithmetic. Bits become numbers, and circuits add, compare, and calculate.

segments.title: A value can stay.
segments.narration: Add memory, and the machine can keep its state. A value survives beyond a single moment.

segments.title: A computer takes shape.
segments.narration: Bring calculation, memory, and control together. Instructions now move through a complete computer.

segments.title: Signals become software.
segments.narration: Software builds on all of it. Every line of code connects back to the machine beneath.

segments.title: Chips and Code
segments.narration: Start with logic. Build from the ground up.
